projects.name: Event-Sourced Ledger — Append-Only Accounting Service
projects.description: An append-only accounting service where an immutable event log is the single source of truth and balances are derived by folding events — giving a full audit trail and time-travel to any past state. Adds optimistic concurrency (HTTP 409 on conflict), atomic two-stream transfers via ordered locking, snapshots every 20 events, and a CQRS read model for fast queries. Benchmarked at ~4,000 transfers/sec in-memory.

projects.name: AI-Powered Structured Extraction API — Text → Validated JSON
projects.description: A REST service that turns unstructured text (emails, invoices) into validated, schema-conformant JSON. It treats LLM output as untrusted with a schema-driven prompt → parse → Bean-Validate → repair-or-fail loop (up to 3 attempts), then fails closed with HTTP 422 rather than returning malformed data. Zero-infra: runs with just Java + Maven.
